params.body:
Two changes for the Studio's Write desk. The Studio pull request that uses them follows; merge this one first, because its Share button calls these routes.

**Sharing a draft**
A draft was visible only to its author until it went to review. An author can now bring chosen colleagues onto a draft:
- `article_shares` (article, user, who shared it, when).
- `visibleTo` and the list filter include drafts shared with the viewer; everyone else still gets the 404 they got before.
- `mayEdit` lets a co-author write; every save still records who made it (`article_edits`).
- `mayShare`: only the author or an admin brings people on or takes them off; a co-author can take themself off.
- `GET /articles/:id/shares` (who is on it, the team to choose from as names only, and whether the caller may share), `POST` `{userId}`, `DELETE /:userId`. They sit behind the existing guard, so someone who cannot see a piece cannot see who is on it either. Only active team members can be added, never the author.
- List rows carry `shared_with` (names), so the desk can say "shared with Bo".
- Deleting a piece deletes its shares.

**Research questions**
- Starting a piece from a question (`POST /research-drafts/:id/piece`) approves it in the same step, with the editor's name. A dismissed question is refused with 409. Until now the Studio needed an approve click before writing could start.
- In the brief's notes a graph source reads by name, "Resale as identity (pattern)", instead of its id.

**Checked**
- New `test/shared-drafts.test.mjs` (7 tests): before and after sharing, editing, who may share, team-only targets, a co-author leaving, deletion. `research-drafts.test.mjs` updated: the old "approve before a piece" rule is replaced by "starting approves", plus a dismissed question is refused.
- Full suite: 1097 of 1103 pass. The 6 failures are `report-render`, which needs `pdftoppm`; the workbench has no poppler, they fail the same way on main, and CI installs it.
- Run against a local pipeline with a seeded database and the Studio on top: Ann shares with Bo, Bo edits (200), Bo's request for Ann's unshared draft is a 404, Bo adding Cy is a 403.
params.title: Drafts can be shared with colleagues; starting to write approves a research question
